scope: Generated demonstration records; not Emirates findings

recommendations.title: Catch incomplete submissions before routing
recommendations.description: Apply explicit field checks and show a request-type-specific example before submission.
recommendations.evidence: 4 selected requests; 0 completed-interval hours and 224 currently open hours. Supporting events: P2P-1003-E03, P2P-1003-E04, P2P-1011-E03, P2P-1011-E04, P2P-1019-E03, P2P-1019-E04, P2P-1027-E03, P2P-1027-E04.
recommendations.assumption: Conditional scenario: reduce correction waits associated with missing information elapsed time by 50% (sensitivity range 25–65%). These percentages are explicit planning assumptions, not estimated treatment effects.
steps: Add and version the relevant submission rules.
Measure return rate and completed turnaround.
recommendations.caveat: Synthetic event evidence only. Open waits are right-censored at the observation timestamp. The scenario estimates elapsed turnaround opportunity, not HR labour or money. Validate benefits in a pilot. Do not sum recommendations without reconciling overlapping event intervals.
